name: lnSwitchboard
description: Host your own Lightning Addresses directly from your node. lnSwitchboard exposes only the public LNURL-pay endpoint while keeping its dashboard and admin routes local on port 22121.
short_desc: Self-Hosted Lightning Addresses for Your Domain
author: RyleaStark

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)

form_fields.label: Bitcoin Network
form_fields.hint: Network mode for Bitcoin node (mainnet, testnet, signet, regtest)
